name: videototext
description: AI video to text for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and Pinterest. Transcribe videos into searchable transcripts, summaries, chapters, and RAG-ready exports via VideoToText MCP.

interface.shortDescription: AI video to text across 7 platforms
interface.longDescription: VideoToText gives ChatGPT and Codex tools to convert YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and Pinterest videos into searchable transcripts. Fetch timestamped text, summarize, search quotes, export TXT/Markdown/JSON/CSV/SRT/VTT, and build RAG chunks with deep links — including YouTube playlists and channels.
defaultPrompt: Get the transcript for this video URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, or Pinterest) and summarize the key points with timestamps.
Search this video transcript for mentions of pricing and quote the exact lines.
Export this video as RAG chunks with deep links.
